svg.title: Learning English Tracker · Database ERD
svg.desc: Ten database entities, primary and foreign keys, relationship cardinality, deletion rules, and quiz history snapshots.
svg.text: Person 3 domain · current model schema · 10 November 2026 · SQLite storage, Django relationships
Read the model, then the relationship
QuizAttemptAnswer is the UserAnswer requested in Person3.md.
User and UserProfile IDs are integers; core and quiz record IDs are UUIDs.
Every Profile has one User. A User may have no Profile in raw DB state.
Deleting a Quiz cascades to its Questions and Choices.
Attempts remain: their live quiz FK becomes NULL.
Deleting source Question/Choice sets answer source FKs to NULL.
Submitted UUIDs, text, correctness and explanation remain snapshots.
Deleting an Attempt cascades to its submitted answers.
Deleting a User cascades to that user's owned learning history.
Model/API validators are not automatically database CHECK constraints.
Only multiple_choice is currently scoreable; other types stay explicit.
Auth Group/Permission tables and AI are outside this ten-model view.
Source: current Django models and forward migrations after P3-08.
Solid: CASCADE Dashed: SET_NULL (nullable source FK) 1 / 0..1 / 0..N: cardinality at each entity
The blue User branches share a bus. PK/FK types reflect the current models; see docs/DATABASE.md for complete fields and rules.
